run_cython_criteo_kaggle: run the cython_criteo script to preprocess Kaggle Criteo dataset from raw text to npz format
run_cython_criteo_terabyte: run the cython_criteo script to preprocess Terabyte Criteo dataset with max index range and memory mapping
run_cython_criteo_custom: run the cython_criteo script with custom sub-sampling rate and randomization options for dataset preprocessing
review_loadDataset: review the loadDataset function from data_utils_cython module used for Criteo dataset preprocessing
